simple.meaning: שְׂמָאלִי (sᵉmâʼlîy) is a Hebrew object word meaning “situated on the left side.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Leviticus 14:15. The surrounding context includes altar, kingship, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׂמָאלִי (H8042) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: שְׂמָאלִי (sᵉmâʼlîy) / H8042 is traced through Leviticus 14:15, Leviticus 14:16, Leviticus 14:26, Leviticus 14:27 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: The priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand.

timeline.evidenceText: The priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand.
The priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before Yahweh.
The priest shall pour some of the oil into the palm of his own left hand;
and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before Yahweh.
He set up the pillars at the porch of the temple. He set up the right pillar, and called its name Jachin; and he set up the left pillar, and called its name Boaz.
The guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, along by the altar and the house, around the king.
He set up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
He set all the people, every man with his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, near the altar and the house, around the king.
“Moreover lie on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel on it. According to the number of the days that you shall lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.
